trials.query: literal category + clue; original combined body field

trials.ranking: descending distinct non-stopword query coverage, raw retrieval score, then document ID

selectionRule: Highest development MRR@10, then accuracy, then Hit@10; exact ties prefer baseline, then title-category, then coverage. Held-out labels are not consulted.
promotionPolicy: Trials are operator-only. This same-author 20-case held-out pilot cannot by itself establish a generally better game opponent. Keep the stable game default.
limitations: Whole first available shard, not a random or representative Wikipedia sample; many B titles and redirects.
605 documents are not labeled answers; they are not exhaustively judged nonrelevant.
Development and held-out answer document IDs are disjoint, but related entities and shared authoring style remain.
Closed-world historical-source support checks are not current factual approval or a human difficulty study.
Held-out means withheld from configuration selection, not independent authorship or a permanently unseen dataset after this run.
